senses.en: having a mutual relationship with something else

example.en: Test scores were closely correlated with attendance rates.
example.zh: 考试成绩与出勤率密切相关。

senses.en: a person who spreads frightening rumors to stir up fear
senses.zh: 危言耸听者；散布恐慌的人

example.en: Don't listen to that scaremonger; the storm is not as bad as he claims.
example.zh: 别听那个危言耸听的人胡说，风暴没有他说的那么严重。

senses.en: to spread alarming rumors or reports to frighten people
senses.zh: 危言耸听；散布恐慌言论

example.en: Some media outlets were accused of scaremongering about the new virus.
example.zh: 一些媒体被指责围绕这种新病毒危言耸听。

senses.en: to transfer blood or other fluid into a person's body, especially into a vein

example.en: Doctors decided to transfuse blood after the surgery.
example.zh: 手术后医生决定输血。

senses.en: to gradually fill someone with a feeling or quality

example.en: The coach transfused confidence into the young team.
example.zh: 教练把信心注入了年轻的队伍。

senses.en: strong public criticism or verbal abuse; disgrace

example.en: The politician fell into obloquy after the scandal.
example.zh: 丑闻之后，那位政客身败名裂。

senses.en: a name or title that identifies someone or something

example.en: The hotel has an official five-star designation.
example.zh: 这家酒店拥有正式的五星级称号。

senses.en: to make people stop believing or trusting something or someone

example.en: New evidence discredited the earlier report.
example.zh: 新的证据使早先的报告失去了可信度。

senses.en: to harm someone's reputation

example.en: The scandal discredited the official.
example.zh: 这桩丑闻败坏了那位官员的名声。

senses.en: loss of reputation or trust

example.en: The failure brought discredit on the whole team.
example.zh: 这次失败使整个团队蒙羞。

senses.en: the act of leaving something out, or something that has been left out

example.en: Her name was missing from the list due to an omission.
example.zh: 由于疏漏，她的名字没有出现在名单上。

senses.en: the sport or activity of riding horses

example.en: She goes riding every weekend.
example.zh: 她每个周末都去骑马。

senses.en: the act of traveling or sitting on a horse or vehicle

example.en: We enjoyed bike riding through the countryside.
example.zh: 我们享受着骑车穿越乡间的乐趣。

senses.en: Referring to the second of two people or things just mentioned.

example.en: Of the two proposals, the latter seems more practical.
example.zh: 两项提议中，后者似乎更实际。

senses.en: Nearer to the end of a period or sequence.

example.en: The latter part of the book is more exciting.
example.zh: 书的后半部分更精彩。

senses.en: The second of two people or things mentioned.

example.en: Both candidates are qualified, but I prefer the latter.
example.zh: 两位候选人都有资格，但我更喜欢后者。

senses.en: the act of agreeing to receive or take something

example.en: Her acceptance of the job offer surprised her friends.
example.zh: 她接受这份工作邀请让朋友们感到惊讶。

senses.en: approval or favorable reception by a group or the public

example.en: The plan won wide acceptance among local residents.
example.zh: 该计划赢得了当地居民的广泛认可。

senses.en: willingness to tolerate or come to terms with a difficult situation

example.en: Acceptance of the loss helped the team move forward.
example.zh: 接受这次失利帮助球队继续前进。

senses.en: to make sure laws or rules are obeyed

example.en: The city enforces parking rules strictly.
example.zh: 该市严格执行停车规定。

senses.en: to make someone do something or make something happen by force

example.en: The court may enforce payment of the fine.
example.zh: 法院可以强制执行罚款的缴纳。

senses.en: a figure of a person or animal made from stone, metal or other solid material

example.en: There is a bronze statue of the founder in front of the school.
example.zh: 学校前面有一座创办人的青铜雕像。

senses.en: to take something that is offered to you willingly
senses.zh: 愿意接受别人提供的东西

example.en: She accepted the gift with a smile.
example.zh: 她微笑着接受了这份礼物。

senses.en: to agree that something is true or reasonable
senses.zh: 承认或认为某事真实、合理

example.en: The team accepted the judge's decision.
example.zh: 团队接受了裁判的决定。

senses.en: to agree to take on a duty or responsibility

example.en: He accepted responsibility for the mistake.
example.zh: 他承担了这次错误的责任。

senses.en: a group of people chosen to discuss or decide matters for a larger organization

example.en: The committee will meet on Friday to review the proposal.
example.zh: 委员会将于周五开会审议该提案。

senses.en: to find the answer or solution to a problem, question, or puzzle

example.en: The team worked together to solve the problem.
example.zh: 团队齐心协力解决了这个问题。

senses.en: to find the value or values that make an equation true

example.en: Students learned how to solve the equation in class.
example.zh: 学生们在课堂上学会了如何解这个方程。

senses.en: opposed to sudden change and favoring traditional values, especially in politics or religion
senses.zh: 保守的；守旧的（尤指政治或宗教上）

example.en: Her conservative views on education emphasize traditional methods.
example.zh: 她保守的教育观点强调传统方法。

senses.en: deliberately lower than expected in an estimate or figure to avoid overstating

example.en: Officials gave a conservative estimate of the cost.
example.zh: 官员们对成本给出了保守的估计。

senses.en: a person who holds conservative views, often a supporter of the Conservative Party
senses.zh: 保守派人士；（常指）保守党支持者

example.en: The bill was supported by conservatives in Congress.
example.zh: 这项法案得到了国会中保守派的支持。

senses.en: considering everything; general rather than detailed

example.en: The overall cost of the project was lower than expected.
example.zh: 该项目的总体成本低于预期。

senses.en: considering everything; generally

example.en: Overall, the team performed well.
example.zh: 总的来说，团队表现良好。

senses.en: loose protective clothing worn over ordinary clothes, usually with trousers and a bib; often plural

example.en: He wore a pair of overalls while painting the fence.
example.zh: 他刷栅栏时穿了一条工装裤。

senses.en: uncertain or unlikely

example.en: It is doubtful whether the meeting will happen on time.
example.zh: 会议能否准时举行还很难说。

senses.en: causing doubt; questionable

example.en: The report is based on data of doubtful accuracy.
example.zh: 这份报告的数据准确性令人怀疑。

senses.en: used to change the subject or return to the main point; anyway
senses.zh: 总之；不管怎样（用于转换话题或回到正题）

example.en: It was raining, but we went out anyhow.
example.zh: 当时在下雨，但我们还是出去了。

senses.en: in a careless or disorganized way
senses.zh: 随随便便地；杂乱无章地

example.en: He threw his clothes on the bed anyhow.
example.zh: 他把衣服随手乱扔在床上。

senses.en: a large molecule made of many repeating smaller units, either natural or synthetic

example.en: Plastic is a common synthetic polymer used in many products.
example.zh: 塑料是一种常见的合成聚合物，用于许多产品中。

senses.en: a place to stay, such as a room or accommodation

example.en: We found cheap lodging near the train station.
example.zh: 我们在火车站附近找到了便宜的住处。

senses.en: a wooden bar placed across the necks of two animals so they can pull together

example.en: The farmer fixed a wooden yoke on the two oxen.
example.zh: 农夫给两头牛装上了木轭。

collocations: put a yoke on the oxen

senses.en: a symbol of burdensome control or bondage

example.en: The people finally threw off the yoke of foreign rule.
example.zh: 人民最终摆脱了外国统治的枷锁。

senses.en: to attach animals with a yoke, or to join two things together

example.en: The workers yoked the oxen to the plow.
example.zh: 工人们把牛套上轭连接到犁上。

senses.en: a common English surname and male given name
senses.zh: 安德森（英文姓氏，也用作男子名）

example.en: Mr. Anderson has worked at the company for ten years.
example.zh: 安德森先生在这家公司工作了十年。

senses.en: a city in Indiana, United States
senses.zh: 安德森市（美国印第安纳州城市）

example.en: Anderson is located in central Indiana.
example.zh: 安德森市位于印第安纳州中部。

senses.en: a person who supports equal rights and opportunities for women
senses.zh: 女权主义者；男女平等主义者

example.en: She has been a feminist since college.
example.zh: 她从大学起就是一名女权主义者。

senses.en: supporting or relating to equal rights for women
senses.zh: 女权主义的；主张男女平等的

example.en: She writes for a feminist magazine.
example.zh: 她为一家女权主义杂志撰稿。

senses.en: the work of managing relations between countries

example.en: The two countries settled the border issue through diplomacy.
example.zh: 两国通过外交解决了边界问题。

senses.en: tactful and skilful handling of people or situations

example.en: She handled the complaint with great diplomacy.
example.zh: 她非常圆通地处理了那起投诉。

senses.en: to apply oil or grease to a machine so it moves smoothly

example.en: You should lubricate the bicycle chain regularly.
example.zh: 你应该定期给自行车链条上润滑油。

senses.en: (of a substance) to make movement between surfaces smooth

example.en: The oil lubricates the moving parts of the machine.
example.zh: 这种油能润滑机器的活动部件。

senses.en: (informal) to facilitate a process or interaction smoothly

example.en: Small gifts can lubricate business relationships.
example.zh: 小礼物可以促进业务关系。

senses.en: things that people or animals eat to live and grow

example.en: We need to buy some food for dinner tonight.
example.zh: 我们需要为今晚的晚餐买一些食物。

senses.en: something that supports thought or discussion

example.en: The book gave her plenty of food for thought.
example.zh: 这本书给了她许多值得思考的东西。

senses.en: the number 8; one more than seven

example.en: There are eight students in the classroom.
example.zh: 教室里有八个学生。

senses.en: the digit or symbol 8; a group of eight people or things

example.en: The winning rowing team is called an eight.
example.zh: 八人赛艇队被称为“八人艇”。

senses.en: extremely distressing or upsetting

example.en: He gave a harrowing account of the disaster.
example.zh: 他对那场灾难作了令人痛心的描述。

senses.en: in Buddhism, the state of liberation from desire and suffering
senses.zh: 涅槃（佛教中脱离欲望与痛苦的解脱境界）

example.en: The monk devoted his life to reaching nirvana.
example.zh: 这位僧人毕生致力于达到涅槃。

senses.en: a state or place of perfect happiness and peace

example.en: Lying on the quiet beach felt like pure nirvana.
example.zh: 躺在安静的海滩上感觉宛如极乐。

senses.en: in a way that uses a lot of energy or effort; strongly and forcefully

example.en: The company strenuously denied the allegations.
example.zh: 该公司坚决否认这些指控。

senses.en: a pipe with a valve, especially one at which firefighters connect hoses to get water from the mains

example.en: Cars may not park in front of a fire hydrant.
example.zh: 汽车不得停在消火栓前。

senses.en: unwilling to change one's position or make concessions
senses.zh: 不妥协的，不让步的，强硬的

example.en: She took an uncompromising stance on safety standards.
example.zh: 她在安全标准问题上态度强硬，毫不妥协。

senses.en: facts or evidence that show something is true

example.en: The police found no proof that he was involved.
example.zh: 警方没有找到他参与其中的证据。

senses.en: a test copy of printed material used for checking

example.en: She read the proofs carefully before the book was printed.
example.zh: 这本书付印前，她仔细校读了样张。

senses.en: able to resist or withstand something harmful or difficult

example.en: The tent is proof against light rain.
example.zh: 这个帐篷能防小雨。

senses.en: to check printed material for mistakes before final printing

example.en: He proofed the report before sending it to the printer.
example.zh: 他把报告校对后才送去印刷。

senses.en: to compensate for or counterbalance something

example.en: The company planted trees to offset its carbon emissions.
example.zh: 这家公司种植树木以抵消其碳排放。

senses.en: something that compensates or balances something else

example.en: Savings from the deal acted as an offset to rising costs.
example.zh: 这笔交易节省下来的钱抵消了上涨的成本。

senses.en: the amount or distance by which something is displaced from a reference point (technical)

example.en: Adjust the offset so the image is centered on the page.
example.zh: 调整偏移量，使图像居中于页面。

senses.en: attractive or interesting

example.en: The salary offer was very appealing to her.
example.zh: 这份薪水对她很有吸引力。

senses.en: showing a request for sympathy or help

example.en: She gave him an appealing look.
example.zh: 她向他投去恳求的目光。

senses.en: family members or relatives

example.en: They gathered all their kin for the wedding.
example.zh: 他们召集了所有亲属来参加婚礼。

senses.en: a weapon for shooting arrows, made of a curved piece of wood with a tight string

example.en: He drew the bow and shot an arrow at the target.
example.zh: 他拉开弓，朝靶子射出一支箭。

senses.en: to bend your head or body forward to show respect or greeting

example.en: The actors bowed to the audience at the end of the show.
example.zh: 演出结束时，演员们向观众鞠躬。

senses.en: a knot with two loops, used for decoration or to tie shoelaces

example.en: She tied the ribbon into a neat bow.
example.zh: 她把丝带系成一个整齐的蝴蝶结。

senses.en: a long wooden rod with horsehair used to play stringed instruments

example.en: The violinist moved her bow smoothly across the strings.
example.zh: 小提琴手用琴弓平滑地在琴弦上拉动。

senses.en: to teach someone skills or knowledge

example.en: She instructs new employees on safety procedures.
example.zh: 她教新员工安全规程。

senses.en: to officially tell someone to do something

example.en: The manager instructed the team to submit the report by Friday.
example.zh: 经理指示团队在周五前提交报告。

senses.en: to formally tell a lawyer or professional to act for you (British usage)
senses.zh: 委托（律师等专业人士）办理

example.en: They instructed a lawyer to handle the case.
example.zh: 他们委托一位律师处理此案。

senses.en: with great urgency or intensity

example.en: She desperately needed a job after losing her savings.
example.zh: 失去积蓄后，她急需一份工作。

senses.en: in a way showing loss of hope

example.en: He searched desperately for a way out of the burning building.
example.zh: 他绝望地在着火的大楼里寻找出路。

senses.en: a sheltered area of water where ships can dock safely

example.en: The ship entered the harbor at dawn.
example.zh: 船在黎明时驶入港口。

senses.en: to keep a feeling, thought, or plan secretly in one's mind

example.en: She harbored doubts about the plan for months.
example.zh: 她对这个计划怀有疑虑好几个月。

senses.en: to give shelter or protection to someone, especially someone hiding from authorities

example.en: He was accused of harboring a fugitive.
example.zh: 他被指控窝藏逃犯。

senses.en: a man who has graduated from a school or university; any former student
senses.zh: 毕业生；校友（男性，或泛指）

example.en: He is an alumnus of Harvard University.
example.zh: 他是哈佛大学的毕业生。

senses.en: not explainable by natural laws; relating to forces beyond the physical world

example.en: The old castle is said to have supernatural powers.
example.zh: 据说那座古堡有超自然的力量。

senses.en: forces, beings and events beyond the natural world, considered collectively
senses.zh: 超自然现象；超自然事物

example.en: Many horror films deal with the supernatural.
example.zh: 许多恐怖电影都涉及超自然现象。

senses.en: the means by which a person earns money to live

example.en: Fishing is the main livelihood of the coastal village.
example.zh: 捕鱼是这个沿海村庄主要的生计。

senses.en: a feeling of great surprise

example.en: She stared at the magic trick in amazement.
example.zh: 她惊讶地盯着那个魔术。

senses.en: widespread destruction or chaos

example.en: The storm wreaked havoc on the village.
example.zh: 暴风雨给村庄造成了严重破坏。

senses.en: mentally healthy and able to think reasonably
senses.zh: 神志健全的；心智正常的

example.en: The court ruled that the defendant was sane at the time of the offense.
example.zh: 法庭裁定被告作案时精神正常。

senses.en: showing good judgment and reasonable thinking

example.en: It seems like a sane decision to save money each month.
example.zh: 每月存点钱似乎是明智的决定。

senses.en: a device that sends out radio or electronic signals

example.en: The radio transmitter broadcasts on FM.
example.zh: 这台无线电发射机以调频广播。

senses.en: a person or animal that spreads a disease

example.en: Mosquitoes are common transmitters of malaria.
example.zh: 蚊子是疟疾的常见传播者。

senses.en: to remove people or things considered unwanted from an organization or place

example.en: The new leader purged several senior officials from the party.
example.zh: 新领导人清洗了党内几名高级官员。

senses.en: to cleanse or rid something of impurities or unwanted contents

example.en: Engineers purged the fuel lines before testing.
example.zh: 工程师在测试前清理了燃油管路。

senses.en: an act of removing unwanted people or things, often by force

example.en: The regime carried out a purge of its critics.
example.zh: 该政权对批评者进行了一次清洗。

senses.en: happening or moving at the same time or rate

example.en: The two motors run in synchronous motion.
example.zh: 两台电机同步运转。

senses.en: deceitful behavior; saying one thing while intending another

example.en: He used duplicity to hide his real plans from his partners.
example.zh: 他用口是心非的手段向合伙人隐瞒自己的真实计划。

senses.en: extremely hot and dry

example.en: We hiked through the scorching desert at dawn.
example.zh: 我们在黎明时分徒步穿过灼热的沙漠。

senses.en: (of criticism or remarks) fierce and harsh

example.en: The report received scorching criticism from experts.
example.zh: 该报告遭到了专家们的严厉批评。

senses.en: a deadly epidemic disease; a destructive plague (archaic or literary)

example.en: In medieval times, pestilence swept through many cities.
example.zh: 在中世纪，瘟疫席卷了许多城市。

senses.en: relating to clothes, tailoring, or style of dress

example.en: He is admired for his impeccable sartorial taste.
example.zh: 他以无可挑剔的穿着品味受到赞赏。

senses.en: the science and practice of designing and flying aircraft

example.en: She studied aeronautics at university.
example.zh: 她在大学学习航空学。

senses.en: the condition of being dealt with first because it is more important

example.en: Safety takes precedence over speed in this factory.
example.zh: 在这家工厂，安全优先于速度。

senses.en: the order of importance among people or things

example.en: Officials entered the hall in order of precedence.
example.zh: 官员们按位次顺序进入大厅。

senses.en: showing or filled with strong emotion

example.en: She gave an impassioned speech about equal rights.
example.zh: 她就平等权利发表了一场充满激情的演讲。

senses.en: holding on firmly; determined and refusing to give up

example.en: The tenacious athlete trained through every setback.
example.zh: 这位顽强的运动员在每次挫折后都坚持训练。

senses.en: holding firmly to memories or ideas

example.en: She has a tenacious memory for names.
example.zh: 她对名字的记忆力很强。

senses.en: gripping tightly; not easily separating

example.en: The material has a tenacious quality that resists tearing.
example.zh: 这种材料坚韧，不易撕裂。

senses.en: a tube or opening through which liquid flows out

example.en: The teapot has a long curved spout.
example.zh: 这个茶壶有一个长长的弯壶嘴。

senses.en: to send out liquid in a fast stream or jet

example.en: Water spouted from the broken pipe.
example.zh: 水从破裂的管子里喷出来。

senses.en: to talk at length in a pompous or tedious way
senses.zh: 滔滔不绝地说；高谈阔论

example.en: He kept spouting facts about wine all evening.
example.zh: 他整晚都在滔滔不绝地讲葡萄酒的知识。

senses.en: difficult situations or questions that need to be dealt with or solved

example.en: The city faces serious traffic problems during rush hour.
example.zh: 这座城市在高峰时段面临严重的交通问题。
